prompts.floor: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for Naki Legend Unity top-down 2D pixel dungeon game. Crisp visible pixel clusters, clean outlines, no smooth airbrush, no text, no watermark. ONE seamless repeating square floor texture, 1024x1024. Wet moss-gray highland flagstones viewed exactly from directly overhead, evenly lit neutral slate blue-gray stone and tiny muted green moss in seams, many subtle chipped irregular stones. Only horizontal ground surface. Low contrast, restrained detail for readable battle bullets. Absolutely no walls, perspective, borders, plants sticking up, symbols, objects, paths, shadows or rain streaks. Left/right and top/bottom edges must tile seamlessly. Opaque texture.

prompts.moth: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for Naki Legend Unity top-down 2D pixel dungeon game. Crisp visible pixel clusters, clean outlines, no smooth airbrush, no text, no watermark. ONE production animation sprite sheet of the SAME charge moth, 4 equally spaced columns by 3 equally spaced rows, EXACTLY 12 cells, on truly transparent background. Target landscape canvas 1536x1152; cells equally sized. Every moth faces right and occupies center 60 percent of its own cell, baseline at 85 percent cell height, huge empty transparent margins so no frame touches adjacent cells. Compact pale-gray broad-winged moth with dark wing rim, cyan-white small abdomen charge sac and two copper antennae. Reading left to right top to bottom: cells 1-6 continuous flight wing flap cycle, wings open then fold then open, same body center; cells 7-9 blue abdomen charging with wings held raised; cell10 firing pose with bright abdomen but NO projectile painted in cell; cell11 red-tinted hurt pose; cell12 folded-wing defeated pose. Consistent same size, same anatomy, crisp chunky pixel art suitable for approximately 48px gameplay body, not a detailed realistic illustration. No grid lines, names, cell labels, background, trails, floating projectiles, or artifacts outside the cell. Moth must visibly flap, not just repeat static drawing.
